description: Test suite for sanitization functions and system prompt construction in a project, using Vitest. It tests functions like sanitizeForPromptLiteral, buildAgentSystemPrompt, and wrapUntrustedPromptDataBlock, focusing on input sanitization, prompt building, and data wrapping.

methods.name: sanitizeForPromptLiteral
methods.description: Sanitizes input string by removing control characters, Unicode separators, and format characters, preserving normal Unicode characters and spaces.

methods.name: buildAgentSystemPrompt
methods.description: Builds a system prompt string with sanitized workspace and sandbox info for an agent.

methods.name: wrapUntrustedPromptDataBlock
methods.description: Wraps sanitized text in a special block tagged to mark data as untrusted, with optional character limit.
